structured_output.what_is_happening: "facet" is a pump.fun token that graduated to PumpSwap about 45 minutes before the snapshot (created 00:07Z, migrated 00:22Z). It links to usefacet.io, an AI review tool where five named models review the same submission and the results are merged into one report. The site does not mention a token. The X account @usefacetio was renamed from FacetSOL around Sep 22. GMGN says the dev's X account has launched 2 tokens, and the packet lists earlier 'facetdefi'/FACET tokens from Sep 25 that died near $3k. The creator has closed out of this token, and GMGN flags it as a community takeover. It rose about 100% in 30 minutes to an ATH near $104k and is now around $77k. Volume is about $105k in the first hour against $23.7k of liquidity, with 359 unique buyers vs 298 sellers. The last 5 minutes show a pullback (GeckoTerminal m5 -9.5%).

narrative.description: A small AI product (a multi-model review tool) tokenized on pump.fun. It fits the AI/'utility dev' meta, but I found no public traction, news or discussion of the product.
narrative.why_spreading: Most likely pump.fun graduation flow plus the AI-product angle drawing degen and bot traders. I found no organic external discussion.

token_connection.why_this_token: The site and X handle on the DexScreener profile and in GMGN match usefacet.io and @usefacetio. It is the only same-name token with liquidity or volume.
token_connection.competing_tokens: Several dead facet/FACET/facetdefi tokens at about $3k mcap with zero liquidity, some from Sep 25. They look like earlier failed launches, possibly tied to the same dev X account (dev_x_account_launched_token_count=2).

authenticity.evidence: GMGN counts 95 bundler wallets and 36 snipers, with a 64% bot/degen rate. There are 12 smart wallets and 1 renowned wallet. Top-10 holders own 21.8%, the largest 2.9%. The dev X account had an earlier failed launch, and the account was renamed from FacetSOL days before launch. There are no paid DexScreener boosts. The site carries no crypto branding.
authenticity.uncertainty: X is inaccessible (HTTP 402), so I cannot see whether the dev endorses the token or whether KOLs are pushing it.

structural_risks: High bundler/sniper counts could mean coordinated selling
Creator has exited, so the coin may depend on a community takeover
Liquidity is only about $23.7k; heavy two-way churn (h1 turnover 4.3x)
Already +100% from its 30-minute low and pulling back from the ATH
The dev's earlier attempt at a similar token failed

structured_output.counterargument: AI-product launches with a real website and a matching X handle can run hard. Holders are well spread (top-10 at 21.8%), mint and freeze are renounced, LP is burned, 12 smart wallets are in, and there are more unique buyers than sellers. The 'creator_close' status plus the CTO flag could just be a clean handoff. Reaching $150k+ is quite plausible if the dev tweets about the token.
unknowns: Who deployed it and whether they are the product dev

source_coverage.notes: The site works (AI multi-model review tool, no token mention). The X profile fetch returned 402. Searching the contract address gave nothing relevant.

structured_output.thesis: A typical early AI-utility graduate: decent holder spread and a clean contract, but bot- and bundler-heavy flow, the creator has exited, the dev account had a prior failed launch, and I found no organic buzz. The chance of doubling from about $77k to $155k is slightly below to around the pool average.
